# Mykrobe parity fixtures

These files are copied from the Mykrobe test suite at commit
`110b4c76120b15750a44991bff4fd961de3b07d7`:

<https://github.com/Mykrobe-tools/mykrobe>

Only fixtures used by this repository's Go parity tests are included. Their
original `tests/ref_data` and `tests/probe_tests` layout is retained so that
the relationship to the upstream tests remains clear.

The files are distributed under Mykrobe's MIT license; see `LICENSE` in this
directory.
